# open app

Open a workspace application.

## Usage

```console
optimus-ide-collab open app [flags] <workspace> <app slug>
```

## Options

### --region

|             |                                     |
|-------------|-------------------------------------|
| Type        | <code>string</code>                 |
| Environment | <code>$OPTIMUS-IDE-COLLAB_OPEN_APP_REGION</code> |
| Default     | <code>primary</code>                |

Region to use when opening the app. By default, the app will be opened using the main Optimus-IDE-Collab deployment (a.k.a. "primary").
